name: Imperator Endgültigst
personality: Rules the known universe and remains irritated by the part called other.
visual_intent: Space Opera Emperor: broad square low ink splat,small copper crown-cap with one orbit ring ABOVE eyes,tiny plum shoulder cape,ONE short command sceptre with smooth ivory orb. Unequal heavy imperious lids,closed toothless immense asymmetric pout,no human armor suit
biography: Rules the known universe and remains irritated by the part called other. His HyperNorm sceptre governs every known orbit and several disputed intentions. A dissonant card asks whether the unknown is allowed to remain unclaimed. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Das Andere liegt knapp außerhalb des genehmigten Universums.

name: Sidekick Zustimmotron
personality: Has calculated the correct response and would like a moment to feel it.
visual_intent: Robot Sidekick but organic ink: tall thin crooked blob,small copper headband with tiny antenna ABOVE eyes,chrome bowtie,ONE chunky hand-held diagnostic pad with THREE round lights,no text. One huge eye one anxious squint,closed nervous toothless zigzag mouth,no metal face/body
biography: Has calculated the correct response and would like a moment to feel it. His three HyperNorm lights calculate a suitable reply before the feeling arrives. A dissonant card waits through the delay without reporting a malfunction. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Zustimmung ist berechnet. Ihre Empfindung folgt später.

name: Duellantin Lichtkante
personality: Can defend a position more quickly than she can decide whether it is hers.
visual_intent: Laser Duelist: round top-heavy asymmetric ink blob,small teal headwrap,two lashes,tiny cream collar,ONE short thick amber light-blade with chunky copper hilt held diagonally down beside body,unbranded,no battle scene. Ecstatic crooked open grin with TWO upper teeth,one brow high
biography: Can defend a position more quickly than she can decide whether it is hers. Her HyperNorm blade wins arguments at the speed of a confident gesture. A dissonant card asks who chose the position she is defending. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Haltung ist verteidigt. Ihre Herkunft wird geprüft.

name: Botschafter Anderswo
personality: Has translated the greeting correctly and is still waiting for the welcome.
visual_intent: Alien Ambassador: squat broad round ink splat,small violet diplomatic cap with TWO little soft antenna ornaments ABOVE eyes,tiny teal sash patch,ONE folded translucent treaty tablet with only THREE abstract dots. Huge unequal eyes gazing sideways,tiny toothless open oval mouth,still TWO eyes and ink anatomy
biography: Has translated the greeting correctly and is still waiting for the welcome. His HyperNorm treaty translates three approved meanings into three unfamiliar dots. A dissonant card offers a welcome that does not require prior equivalence. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Übersetzung ist korrekt. Die Begrüßung steht noch aus.

name: Kapitänin Kursungefähr
personality: Keeps the crew moving while command argues about the direction of progress.
visual_intent: Starship Captain: tall broad-based pear ink blob,small cream peaked retro-space cap,two lashes,tiny dark collar,ONE brass compass-like star-navigation dial and folded chart. Heavy fed-up uneven lids,closed toothless crooked dry side-smile
biography: Keeps the crew moving while command argues about the direction of progress. Her HyperNorm chart keeps the crew moving through revisions called progress. A dissonant card asks whether checking on a tired crewmate could count as a useful course. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Richtung wurde bis zur nächsten Lagebesprechung beibehalten.

name: Lochesser Restkosmos
